description: This Kotlin file defines a singleton object ServiceLocator responsible for dependency injection and provisioning of ViewModels in the application. It manages the initialization of application context, database, repository, and provides a factory for creating TaskViewModel instances.

classes.name: ServiceLocator
classes.description: A singleton object that manages dependency creation for the app, including database, repository, and ViewModel factories.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ServiceLocator with application context, sets up the database and repository.

methods.name: provideTaskViewModelFactory
methods.description: Provides a ViewModelProvider.Factory that creates TaskViewModel instances with the repository dependency.
